title: Snail
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snail body -->
  <path d='M12 74 Q10 84 22 84 L72 84 Q86 84 86 74 Q86 66 74 66 L30 66 Q18 66 12 74 Z' fill='#7fd67f'/>
  <!-- body shading/underside -->
  <path d='M14 80 Q16 86 24 86 L72 86 Q84 86 85 78 Q78 82 68 82 L22 82 Q16 82 14 80 Z' fill='#4fae4f'/>
  <!-- foot base -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='84' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#a8efa8'/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='25' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- shell rim -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='25' fill='none' stroke='#f7d07a' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d='M54 52 Q54 40 66 40 Q80 40 80 54 Q80 68 64 68 Q48 68 44 54 Q42 44 50 38' fill='none' stroke='#b96f16' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spiral highlight -->
  <path d='M54 52 Q54 44 62 44' fill='none' stroke='#fbe2a8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell glow spot -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='4' fill='#fbe2a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='62' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#7fd67f'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <line x1='23' y1='52' x2='20' y2='38' stroke='#7fd67f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='52' x2='34' y2='38' stroke='#7fd67f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='36' r='5' fill='#c9f7c9'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='5' fill='#c9f7c9'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#2b6b2b'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#2b6b2b'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M22 66 Q28 71 34 65' fill='none' stroke='#2b6b2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='60' r='3' fill='#f7a3c0'/>
</svg>
